tei:div.tei:p: "$ (523)༄༅// nā ro chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa tshig nyung ngur byas pa bzhugs so//

(524)༄༅// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang shes rab bzang*// ye shes dngos grub bde ba'i rdo rje dang*// bzhad pa'i rdo rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rdo rje rgyal po mnyam med rat+na shrī// bsod nams grags dang rdo rje grags pa dang*// rin chen seng ge grags pa bsod nams zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje rgyal po dang*// chos kyi rgyal po don grub rgyal po'i mtshan// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhabs// gsol ba= /ngag gi dbang po rin chen chos rgyal dang*// ā nan+da zhabs rat+na drag po rtsal// dpal gyi rgya mtsho sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal// gsol ba= /rdo rje 'chang dbang mkhan chen rnam 'joms zhabs// bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba= /ma dag las kyi phung khams skye mched rnams// rnam dag dbang bzhis sku bzhi ye shes lngar// rab sbyangs mngon byas sa lam kun rdzogs par// bdag rgyud yongs su smin par byin gyis rlobs// med bzhin las 'khrul bag chags kyis bslad pa'i// ngar 'dzin lus kyi grong khyer 'dus byas chos// gsal stong yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// zung 'jug bskyed rim rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /sprul pa'i 'khor lor a thung sbar ba'i mes// ra la srog rtsol nyi zla'i rgyu ba kun// dhū ti sgra gcan khyim du rab bsad nas// 'bar 'dzag bde drod mi rtog mthar phyin shog /chos kyi 'khor lor dwangs ma 'od klong du// rlung sems 'byung bzhi snang mched thob pa'i tshogs// skad cig thim nas tshogs drug gis stong pa'i// don gyi 'od gsal mchog la gnas par shog /longs spyod 'khor lor rlung sems rab 'dus shing*// sa (525)bon bsam gtan sbyor bas nying 'khrul kun// rang ngo shes shing sprul bsgyur sgyu mar rtogs// rtsal 'byongs bogs thon 'khrul pa drungs 'byin shog

/bde chen 'khor lor phyi nang rten 'byung gi /dag dang ma dag brten g.yo ma lus pa// bcos min sgyu mar rtogs shing 'jug ldang gis// don gyi sgyu lus rtogs pa thob gyur cig /'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba rang sems nyid// rang mdangs longs skur rnam par go 'pho zhing*// gnas skabs rlung sems yig 'bru'i sbyor ba yis// 'pho dang grong 'jug gegs med 'grub par shog /bar do rang ngo shes shing dbang 'byor te// 'od gsal sgyu ma'i 'jug ldang gnad zab mos// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa rtsad bcad nas// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin zhing sogs bgrod gyur cig /ma dag nyon mongs rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros// lha sngags ting 'dzin sbyor bas gnas bsgyur zhing*// zhugs gnas thim dang 'gros bzhi mthar phyin nas// nyon mongs ma spangs lam du lhong bar shog /dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs// rtsa ba yan lag bsrung mtshams ji snyed pa// nyes pas ma gos tshul bzhin legs bsrungs nas// mchog dman dngos grub bde blag 'grub gyur cig /rang don yan lag bdun ldan chos kyi sku// skad cig mngon thob de yi rang mdangs rtsal// mchog dman bar ma'i snang ngor longs sprul sogs// chu zla lta bus 'gro kun grol gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang sogs brjod// ces nā ro chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshig tu 'dur byas pa 'di yang*/ lcam zhabs drung gi bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor lam 'dis grol ba 'bri gung pa rin chen chos kyi grags pas shing sprel rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus dge bar/ 'bri chos phyug klung gi pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su mgyogs par sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu/// /maṅga lam//
